concept: Authoritative legal identity for Cronauer Law: a deep navy primary conveys trust and established expertise, paired with a refined antique-gold accent for distinction and prestige. Near-black ink sits on soft warm-white backgrounds for a classic, professional, highly legible reading experience.
contrastNotes: All ratios verified WCAG-AA+. ink on bg 16.77:1 (>=7); ink-soft on bg 7.34:1 (>=4.5); white on primary 14.62:1 (>=4.5); primary on bg 13.67:1 (>=3). Also: ink on surface 17.93:1; ink-soft on surface-alt 6.60:1; white on primary-dark 17.17:1; white on secondary 7.88:1; gold accent on bg 4.33:1 and white on accent 4.64:1 (both pass AA for text/UI). Line color is decorative (non-text).
